# Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer — Torque Dynamics

**Torque Dynamics** designs electronic control units for electric vehicles. Our firmware runs in braking, steering and battery management systems on production vehicles, and our engineering team of about two hundred people works from labs in Munich and Detroit.

## About the role

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to join the Battery Management Systems team. You will write safety-critical firmware for automotive microcontrollers, work through the full safety lifecycle, and bring up new hardware on the bench.

## What you will do

- Develop real-time firmware in C for automotive microcontrollers running an RTOS.
- Implement software components to the AUTOSAR Classic standard, including the basic software stack and complex device drivers.
- Design and review software for functional safety, following ISO 26262 up to ASIL C and D.
- Implement and debug CAN bus and CAN FD communication, diagnostics and bootloaders.
- Use oscilloscopes, logic analysers and JTAG debuggers to bring up and debug boards.
- Write unit and integration tests, and support hardware-in-the-loop test benches.
- Contribute to safety cases, reviews and audits.

## Requirements

- 6+ years of embedded firmware development in C.
- Experience with an RTOS and low-level hardware interfaces such as SPI, I2C and ADC.
- Working knowledge of AUTOSAR and ISO 26262.
- Experience with CAN bus.
- A degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering or a related field.

## Nice to have

- Experience with battery management systems or motor control.
- MISRA C compliance and static analysis experience.
